Subject: GridHealth discovery — next steps & TDX options

Hi Samir / Megan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the ML/infra deep dive scheduled: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: validate production serving approach for real-time inference in GridHealth's triage pipeline (99th pctl latency target ~150ms, bursty traffic)
- Key constraints: PHI-adjacent data flows, SSO, SOC2 evidence, retention and audit logs
- Stakeholders: Samir (Dir Eng), Megan (VP Eng), product + infra folks on your side

Proposed Technical Deep Dive (TDX)
- Format: 60–90 min hands-on/ops-focused session with Redwood ML + infra engineers
- Objectives: service topology, runtime optimizations (batching, KV cache), quantization/throughput tradeoffs, security preflight (SSO/KMS), and a short Q&A + next steps checklist

Availability (please pick preferred slot or propose alternatives)
- Wed Apr 7 — 09:00–10:30 PT or 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu Apr 8 — 13:00–14:30 PT
- Fri Apr 9 — 16:00–17:30 PT

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Marcus Lin (ML Infra), Lauren Bishop (Security/CS), Ben Carter (Solutions), myself. Please confirm who will attend from your side and any additional topics to include (e.g., compliance runbook, data-flow diagrams).

Attachments: tdx-agenda-v1.pdf (draft), redwood-security-onepager.pdf — quick reference for SOC2/KMS support.

If those slots don't work, tell me windows that do and we will align internally. Once we lock time I'll send a calendar invite and short prep list (what to bring: sequence length distribution, typical batch sizes, peak TPS).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
